useCases.title: Start on anyrouter/free or anyrouter/auto
useCases.problem: A first request that pins a single free SKU often 404s or 429s. You want something that is answering right now, with automatic fallback.

snippets.code:
curl https://anyrouter.dev/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ANYROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "anyrouter/free",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Say hello in one sentence." }]
  }'

steps: Create a key. anyrouter/free needs the Go plan ($2/mo) or a donated provider key; it does not deduct credits and has no daily limit.
Call model anyrouter/free for the subsidized free chain, or anyrouter/auto for paid models that are healthy right now.
Read the model pages and the free-tier docs for failover behavior.
